newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-DE VILLIERS INJURED AFTER MOWING LAWN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DE VILLIERS INJURED AFTER MOWING LAWN.

text.p: South African test player Fanie de Villiers will be out of action for a month after injuring his hand while working on his garden.
De Villiers suffered muscle damage to two of his fingers while adjusting his lawnmower it was announced by his union, Northern Transvaal, in a press release on Thursday.
Doctors suspect the player may also have suffered damage to the nerves in his fingers which will only be apparent after further tests. De Villiers said he expects to be unable to play for a month.
